seoTitle: Webcam Color Sampler: Read a Real-World Color via Camera
metaDescription: Point your camera at an object and read the average colour under a box as HEX and RGB. Free, local, nothing recorded.
intro: Shows the live camera view with a sampling box and reports the average colour inside it as HEX and RGB. Save colours into a list.
why:
Matching a paint chip or a fabric starts with a number. The tool averages a small box of pixels, which reduces camera noise. Move the box with sliders and set its size.

Camera auto white balance and lighting change what is measured, so use a neutral light and compare with a known reference. The video stays in your browser.
howTo: Press Start camera and allow access.
Move the box over your object with the position sliders.
Press Save this colour to keep a value.
Click a saved colour to copy it.
